name: Oyacho Agawase
description: A small seaside village in Japan, blending working harbor life, quiet lanes, and hillside views.

locations.name: Seaside Station
locations.description: A modest local rail stop where commuters and students pass through each day.

locations.name: Fishing Harbor
locations.description: A compact harbor with moored trawlers, stacked crates, and gulls circling overhead.

locations.name: Morning Market
locations.description: A dawn market for fresh catch, produce, and local snacks under striped awnings.

locations.name: Nagawase Main Street
locations.description: The village commercial lane with small eateries, a post office, and family-run shops.

locations.name: Shrine Steps
locations.description: Stone steps leading to a hill shrine, bordered by lanterns and seasonal flowers.

locations.name: Sea Wall Promenade
locations.description: A concrete coastal walk where villagers jog, chat, and watch the evening tide.

locations.name: Breakwater
locations.description: A long arm of tetrapods and stone that shelters the harbor from rough waves.

locations.name: Beach Cove
locations.description: A narrow sandy cove with driftwood, tide pools, and strong sea breezes.

locations.name: Rice Terrace Path
locations.description: A stepped rural footpath overlooking patchwork rice fields and the shoreline.

locations.name: Hilltop Cemetery
locations.description: A quiet cemetery with weathered stones and a sweeping view of the village below.

locations.name: Community Bathhouse
locations.description: A neighborhood sento with tiled baths, changing rooms, and a relaxed evening crowd.

locations.name: Elementary School
locations.description: A small schoolyard and classroom block that grows quiet after afternoon dismissal.
